recipes.oracle_text: {T}: This creature deals 1 damage to any target.

recipe_coverage: Reviewed whole-text ordinary mana/tap damage component: Oracle casting cost/stats and keywords, damage target scope and printed backlash/tapping/life loss, activation costs before resolution, both controllers, own and opposing targets, tap and sickness restrictions, haste immediately after real casting, exact/missing/wrong-color mana, cancellation, target/source loss, repeated untapping with Vitalize, damage cleanup, owned stocked zones and empty variants, and pending activation replay after AI backups. Flash timing, planeswalkers, protection/prevention/redirection, countering activated abilities, multiplayer and other combined mechanics remain gaps. Component coverage, not whole-card certification.
